headers.comment: A first visit downloads ~15MB: one WASM variant plus the face model. Without these headers that repeats on every visit, which on mobile data is slow and expensive. Both paths are version-pinned, so a year is safe.
Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a new build produces new URLs.
The entry point must NOT be cached, or a redeploy strands phones on the old build with no way to refresh out of it.
